data.gender_notes: Leeann is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Leeann is derived from the name Leannan, which means gentle in Irish. The addition of the suffix -ann makes the name mean gentle lion. In biblical terms, the lion is a symbol of courage and strength, making Leeann a name for a strong yet gentle woman. The name Leeann carries the meaning “Gentle Lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leeann usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leeann total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
